answer_1.quote: Condensing a vast collection of texts into comprehensible summaries is a crucial and challenging task. Timeline summarization (TLS) represents a specialized topic within this area, focusing on distilling event narratives from many texts to summarize the development of specific events or topics over time.
answer_1.outputs: Timeline summaries for events and topics

answer_2.quote: Performance is measured by precision, recall, and F1. ... For summarization, we assess with ROUGE F1 scores (ROUGE-1, ROUGE-2, ROUGE-L). Alignment-based ROUGE F1-score (AR) ... Date F1-score (Date-F1) ...
